situation: Handling document OCR in a VLM-centric pipeline.
decision: Run GLM-OCR (0.9B) separately as an edge service for documents rather than repeatedly sending every document through a large VLM.
reasoning_physics: A 0.9B specialized OCR model is far cheaper per-request and better suited to high concurrency + K3s edge than a 20GB+ VLM. Routing the high-frequency, low-difficulty task to the small model spares the large model for tasks it alone can do.
